items.title: ACT-CLINEMM-SEATBELT-SSH-AGENT-AUTHORITY-IMPLEMENTATION01 — SSH-agent credential authority implementation
items.description: Executable qualification of the frozen `sshAuthenticationAuthority: deny | agent` contract (§15 of RECON01). Production-seam code at HEAD `ff96ea8fe` (the C1 correction cycle) implements the contract: `CommandCapability.sshAuthenticationAuthority` field in `sdk/packages/core/src/runtime/sandbox/types.ts`; `path-literal` AF_UNIX system-socket + remote unix-socket rules in `seatbelt-profile.ts`; `materializeEnvironment` step-3 allow list reintroduces `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` only in agent mode without weakening `SECRET_BLOCKLIST`; activation via `apps/vscode/src/sdk/sandbox-policy.ts` under the temporary env control `CLINEMM_SAFE_YOLO_SSH_AGENT=allow` (the temporary control is itself catalogued for replacement by the settings-surface-parity recon). Phase E/F/G LIVE qualification captured 2026-08-29: SSH_AUTH_SOCK visible, ssh-add shows the RSA key, raw-key `cat` returns EPERM (load-bearing invariant), outbound SSH to `ubuntu@81.177.33.219` returns `SSH_AGENT_AUTH_OK` from host `indeep01`. 4 host-substrate tests (SSH-03/04/06/12) report SKIP under `HAS_SUBSTRATE === false` in this VSCodium authoring shell; they flip to PASS on Terminal.app / iTerm2 / debug-harness without code change.
criteria: `CommandCapability.sshAuthenticationAuthority` field present with the closed union `undefined | { mode: "agent", resolvedAuthSock }`.
Seatbelt backend emits the two-rule agent SSH pair exactly as RECON01 §5.1 specifies, with `path-literal` (NOT filesystem `literal`, NOT `subpath`).
`materializeEnvironment` reintroduces `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` only when the capability's env allow list contains it (step 3 wins over step 4); `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` stays in `SECRET_BLOCKLIST`.
Substrate-gated RED suite passes on Terminal.app / iTerm2 / debug-harness for SSH-03..SSH-14.
No launchd socket parent directory is added to any filesystem grant list.
reopen_conditions: The `readonly`-identity-file mode is out of scope for V1; renegotiating the frozen §15 contract requires a NEW recon ACT.
